channel.title: council-brief: Blue Ridge and Fannin County meetings
channel.description: New summaries of local government meetings in Blue Ridge and Fannin County, Georgia.

item.title: City Council Workshop, November 10, 2026
item.description: The City Council Workshop reviewed the Fiscal Year 2027 proposed budget presented by Eric Soroka, including general fund increases and utility extension policies supported by Commissioner Hensley. The session also addressed open records, a winter ice skating event contract, public comment on homelessness, and suggestions for long-term harm-reduction strategies. Votes: Extend the time: result unclear from the recording.

item.title: Planning Commission, November 3, 2026
item.description: The Planning Commission reviewed two rezoning requests and a hotel development proposal, including site analysis, utility plans, and stormwater management requirements. Commissioners discussed engineering challenges on Shamrock Road, parking codes, and long-range planning goals while residents raised concerns about traffic, growth controls, and the potential for future development without the hotel project. Votes: Approved the minutes and agenda. Rezone the property to C2: result unclear from the recording. Rezone the property to Central Business District (CBD): died for lack of a second. Rezone partial land to C2 with staff conditions: passed (4-1 per the official record). Approve a conditional use permit for the hotel: failed (2-3 per the official record).

item.title: Fannin County Board of Commissioners, October 27, 2026
item.description: The Fannin County Board of Commissioners discussed a blood and plasma purchase agreement with LifeSouth for emergency transport, which costs $15,889.98 and is partially funded by a grant. The board also debated the legal status of Jasper Road, addressing concerns about its maintenance over two decades despite gaps in official county records and questions regarding state road abandonment laws. Votes: Approve the minutes from the October 13 meeting: result unclear from the recording. Approve the contract with the Fannin County Chamber of Commerce: passed. Purchase the 2026 Chevrolet truck: passed. Approve the purchase of blood and plasma units for $15,889.98 with a $12,000 grant: passed. Adjourn: passed.
